criteo_ad_set_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time an ad set's delivery status changes in Criteo, such as from live to paused or ended, with the status it had before. Changes made before the workflow is turned on, and new ad sets, don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.activation_status: on or off: whether it is set to deliver.

output.previous_status: The delivery status before the change (status changes only).
